status: Approved by Claude on delegated authority from the science-model owner, 14 November 2026. Thresholds are data-derived drafts. Flagged items need a check against the cited source before release.

passed.rule: SIM 3292 unit code has N in its age prefix; support 1.0 if Noachian only, 0.6 if it spans to Hesperian or Amazonian
unit code has H in its age prefix
unit code has A in its age prefix; support 1.0 if Amazonian only, 0.6 if mixed

passed.note: Only craters large enough to be mapped at 1:20M.

passed.rule: unit in lAv, lAvf, Av, Ave
max SWIM consistency over the three depth ranges; support 0 at <=0, linear to 1.0 at >=0.5; evaluated only where SWIM is not null (|lat| < 59.7 deg)
max of SWIM 1-5 m and >5 m consistency, same mapping
measured TES night thermal inertia; support 0 below 350, linear to 1.0 at 500 tiu; interpolated samples not evaluated

passed_with_flag.flag: ANa sits at 37-49 deg latitude, where lobate debris aprons occur. lAa sits on the Tharsis Montes flanks. The glacial reading of both units must be confirmed in the SIM 3292 unit descriptions.
Aa clusters around Olympus Mons and Valles Marineris. Confirm the aureole and landslide interpretation in SIM 3292.

passed_with_flag.rule: no layer of its own; supported only through narrower concepts outflow and ice
passed_with_flag.flag: A water objective currently ranks flood channels and ice. It cannot see lakes, rivers, deltas or alteration minerals.

not_passed_no_layer.needs: A valley-network map and a delta and paleolake catalogue joined to cells.
A mineral-detection catalogue with mineral classes. The CRISM field in the records only says a targeted observation exists.
IAU gazetteer feature footprints (Fossa, Chasma, Chaos, and so on) or SIM 3292 structure lines joined to cells.
A crustal magnetic field map and marsquake source locations.
These are interpretations. They need a reviewed rule that combines other layers, or curated site lists.

rejected.reason: Presence of a targeted observation is coverage, not a detection. Used in the Records column only. 1,962 cells.
One nine-day window in 2000 on a 6 x 3 degree grid. Environment context only.
Ambiguous alone. Used only together with thermal inertia.
All 196,608 cells are Unclassified with identical bounds in all but four cells.
Counts reflect targeting choices. Used in the Records column only.
56 single points, one cell each, no footprints.
14,577 cells are interpolated and 249 have no positive sample. Treated as not evaluated.

sparse_rule.no_metadata: No cell. Every record has MOLA elevation and albedo.
sparse_rule.sparse: No geologic unit, OR neither a measured thermal-inertia sample nor a SWIM value.
sparse_rule.per_concept: Each concept also carries its own evaluated mask. A cell outside a layer's coverage is not evaluated for that concept and is never scored zero.

grouping_rule.connectivity: 8 neighbours from the exact HEALPix nested neighbour function
grouping_rule.area: Connected matching cells, split at Nside-32 parent tiles (16 cells, about 108 km across)
grouping_rule.point_layers: CRISM, HiRISE and DTM hits stay as points attached to an area. They are not grouped.

exclusions.polar: |lat| >= 60 deg or unit group = Polar Units

method_gates.sample-rock: rocky-surface support > 0, or not dust-mantled where thermal inertia is measured; otherwise not established
method_gates.investigate-ice: ice support >= 0.5, or polar-cap, or glacial-apron
method_gates.remote-survey: always compatible; show CTX and HiRISE record counts
